content:
The early fall Amazon Prime Day sale rolls in with a collection of new discounts, alongside the solid $50 price drop on the brand new Mac Studio and up to $150 off M5 MacBook Air models. We are also now tracking deep $500 price drop on both the Silver and Space Black 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, ongoing Apple Watch Ultra 3 clearance discounts, loads of TV deals, and a host of new accessory offers from Twelve South, Anker, and more. Scope it all out down below.

M5 Pro MacBook Pro now $500 off at Amazon in Silver and Space Black

There are still some notable deals live on the latest M5 MacBook Air for less, but we wanted to circle back on the major $500 price drop Amazon is serving up on this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro – both the Space Black and Silver models are now sitting at the heavily discounted sale price.

Amazon is currently offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage capacity down at $2,699 shipped.

This is matching the lowest price we have tracked in months, but you will now find it available on both the Space Black and Silver variants – the latter isn’t typically discounted quite as often as the black.

This is a regularly $3,199 machine and is now sitting at $500 off the list price. As we touched on previously, in a world where loads of tech deals are just bringing prices back down to the former MSRP, this particular discount is actually $100 less than the price this machine fetched before the sweeping Apple price increases in late June.

Most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air now $100 off, 24GB model $150 off

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (Reg. $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,399 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,849 (Reg. $1,999)

Rare clearance deals hit small and medium-size black Apple Watch Ultra 3 models, more up to $200 off

The all-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 is all the way here now and there are still some early launch deals on various configurations, but Amazon is also serving up some deals on the now previous-gen and still perfectly capable Apple Watch Ultra 3 for a whole lot less than that.

The black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with that gorgeous Milanese Loop remains the super hot deal here – you can land this one at nearly $200 off the original $899 list price right now. This is very much the most notable of the clearance deals here, but there are some additional configurations landing on sale this morning as well.

You will want to keep this in mind though: The other configs are now sitting at the same price as the Milanese variant above with the premium woven metal band. The thing is that deal at nearly $200 off is only available in the large size, whereas there are some medium and small options at $100 off right now as well – typically, these sought after medium-size configs rarely see deals as often as the others:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Alpine Loop $699 (Orig. $799) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Milanese Loop $799 (Orig. $899) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Trail Loop $699 (Orig. $799) | Small

Again, the black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the matching Milanese Loop in the large size is still the very best deal here, but considering how rare the medium size deals can be sometimes, we thought we would get these on the radar.

And here are some of the Apple Watch Ultra 4 models with light launch discounts:

Apple’s new 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio is now $50 off at Amazon

Alongside the return of the early launch deals on the much more affordable M6 Mac mini, those looking to step to the more powerful new 2026 Mac Studio Apple just released will find it sitting at a new all-time low on Amazon right now.

Amazon is now offering the new M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM and the 512GB storage down at $2,449 shipped.

This is a regularly $2,499 machine with a solid $50 price drop. That’s certainly not a massive discount, but if you are looking to upgrade in the early days you might as well keep the $50 in your pocket – this $1 under the pre-order discount.

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (Reg. $2,499)

Amazon didn’t officially carry the previous Mac Studio configs so it is hard to predict how deal pricing might go on this one moving forward. It has, thus far, seen early launch deals similar to the new M6 Mac mini, but Amazon tends to get a little bit aggressive at launch on new Apple gear and it’s hard to say if this pro-grade machine will actually drop in price for Prime Day and Black Friday or not. It’s certainly not out of the question to see it at closer to $100 off or something along those lines later this year, but as of right now we can’t say with any level of confidence.

Either way, early adopters can save some cash, and the early M6 Mac mini deals have returned on select configs for those who just don’t need the M5 Max power and 36GB of RAM:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (Reg. $1,299)

Many of the deals are live or even lower at Amazon, but there is some gear only marked down on its official site as well.

You’ll find all of the Amazon deals waiting right here, with some additional highlights organized below, and you can use code FALL20 on the official Twelve South site to knock 20% off just about anything (just be sure to double check the price at Amazon first).

Upgrade your TV ahead of GTA VI release at up to $1,100 off: LG, Samsung, Hisense, more

While the extremely divisive Collector’s Box release didn’t go over very well, we are in for some exclusive new details on the experience later today and we are tracking loads of notable TV deals to upgrade the game room ahead of release.
